articles.headline: GIL INVESTOR ALERT: Hagens Berman Urges Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL) Investors with Substantial Losses to Contact Firm Ahead of Dec. 14 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
articles.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Gildan Activewear Inc. alleging revenue inflation through channel stuffing, false organic growth metrics, and overstated M&A synergies. Following an investigative report by Jehoshaphat Research on June 16, 2026, Gildan's stock plummeted 18.75%. Investors who suffered substantial losses during the class period (Feb. 19, 2025 – June 15, 2026) are urged to contact Hagens Berman before the December 14, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

articles.headline: DAVA IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Endava plc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – DAVA
articles.summary: Multiple securities class action lawsuits have been filed against Endava plc, Fluence Energy Inc., AST SpaceMobile Inc., Lincoln Educational Services Corp., and Gildan Activewear Inc. for alleged materially false statements, misleading disclosures, and internal control failures. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to join the class actions before respective deadlines.

articles.headline: Kaplan Fox Alerts Investors of Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL) to a Pending Securities Class Action – Deadline is December 14, 2026
articles.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Gildan Activewear for investors who purchased securities between February 19, 2025 and June 15, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Gildan engaged in channel stuffing and lacked adequate internal controls to artificially inflate revenues by approximately $500 million. Following a short-seller report on June 16, 2026, Gildan's stock fell 18.7%. The deadline to join the class action is December 14, 2026.
